sentences.text: Huoshanornis is a genus of enantiornithine birds, a group defined by its unique skeletal features.
This creature lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago in the Early Cretaceous period.
The genus was first named in 2010 by Xia Wang, Zihui Zhang, Chunling Gao, Lianhai Hou, Qingjin Meng, and Jinyuan Liu.
Fossil remains were discovered at Chaoyang City within the Jiufotang Formation of Western Liaoning Province, China.
